title: Dickerson's band personnel and Lil Armstrong's band at Dreamland
summary: He lists Dickerson sidemen (Henry Gordon, Buster Bailey, Rudy Jackson, drummers) and says he worked with Lil Armstrong at Dreamland; he struggles to recall the others.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
